transcript.text: Alright, let's get started. We're here to finalize the change request for retiring the legacy CI runner image and moving all repositories to the replacement image. The replacement has passed the standard build, integration, and security smoke tests as of today, June 14. The draft proposal targets June 21 for disabling the legacy image fleet-wide. Before I can approve and record the final plan, I need release engineering and security compliance to state any blockers or required controls. Let's hear from both of you — what do we need to address before I settle this change record?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have a blocker to report. While handling a failed build this morning, I confirmed that the Atlas and Birch repositories still require a compiler that is only available in the legacy runner image. Their migration work will take exactly 10 business days, landing on June 28. I haven't updated the change request yet because the migration estimate was confirmed only this morning. This means the June 21 target date for disabling the legacy image fleet-wide is not feasible — we'd need to push it to at least June 28.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a required control to state. During a compliance evidence review yesterday, I confirmed that every production CI build using the replacement image must emit signed provenance records retained for exactly 365 days before the legacy image can be retired. I have not filed the control update yet because the evidence review is still being reconciled. So in the approved target configuration, signed_provenance_enabled must be required, and this control needs to be in place before we retire the legacy image.
transcript.speaker: A3
